name: reqogniloom
description: SE-domain agent roles + native MCP connection for a ReqogniLoom requirements/architecture/test workspace.

mcp_url.title: ReqogniLoom URL
mcp_url.description: Base URL, no path; do not end in /mcp (e.g. https://reqlo.example.com)

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: ReqogniLoom API key created in your workspace settings. Tools that publish proposals (e.g. traceability.suggest_links) need an agent-principal key with write scope; a plain user key is refused for those calls.

workspace_id.title: Workspace ID
workspace_id.description: UUID of the workspace that listen-mode capture sends to. Required to enable listen mode; leave empty otherwise.
